record.title: Santa Rosa–Chacalluta intermittent transporters’ blockade demanding longer opening hours, November 2023
record.scope: Vehicle access near Santa Rosa on the Tacna–Arica international road
record.direction: Vehicle entry and exit at the crossing affected.
record.movement: Cross-border motor vehicles and passengers using collective taxis and buses.
record.exceptions: Intermittent vehicle passage and people walking past the obstruction are explicitly reported.
record.imposing_authority: Peruvian cross-border collective-taxi and bus operators
record.enforcement: Drivers and vehicles occupied the road; police attended and officials negotiated.
record.consequences: Vehicle queues and passengers walking around the blocked transport route.
record.relationship: Promotes the November component of R3-AM-L010. Distinct operators and demands from April/June migrant blockades. Routine opening hours are context only.
record.status_observation: Status limited to dated evidence; no claim of present closure.
record.official_rationale: Operators demanded round-the-clock border service and faster processing.
record.context: This record covers deliberate protest obstruction, not the ordinary operating schedule that prompted it.
record.uncertainty: Andina reports road clearance around midday after talks, but a later-published La República text still describes intermittent obstruction. Publication time may not equal observation time. Same-day restoration is retained as reported, not proof of a final uninterrupted endpoint; exact hours and later recurrence unresolved.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. November 29 intermittent blockade; same-day clearance reported by Andina. Conflicting later wording and passage windows preclude a continuous interval.
